name: com.modelpiper/toolpiper
description: 300+ MCP tools for macOS, all on-device — local LLM inference, voice (STT/TTS on the Neural Engine), vision/OCR, RAG, browser automation, testing, and ~140 system actions across 26 macOS domains. No cloud, no API keys.

_meta.setup: Install ToolPiper from https://modelpiper.com, then: claude mcp add --transport http toolpiper http://127.0.0.1:9998/mcp (or stdio: claude mcp add toolpiper -- ~/.toolpiper/mcp)
